bill.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to eliminate the State and local tax deduction marriage penalty.

action.description: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

posted_text:
💰 Taxation
US HR 9626 — You Could Get a Bigger Tax Break on Your Marriage

This bill changes how much you can deduct for state and local taxes. It increases the amount you can deduct if you're married – up to 200% of the amount if you file a joint return, and 100% if you file separately. It also adjusts the dollar thresholds for these deductions, making them higher for married couples. These changes will take effect for tax years starting after December 31, 2026. .. .... ..
